about: Fingerprints glazier-core made of the corpus beside this file, for Oriel to match bit for bit (plan 063). Hex strings are raw bytes; `drawn` stills are drawn at test time; videos go through the ffmpeg on PATH. Made by glazier-core's similarity/fingerprint-vectors.test.ts. Frozen when Electron Oriel and glazier-core were removed (plan 063): Oriel's engine is the only implementation, and this is what it must still produce.
